v1.0.0.description:
This is the first full release of the Mina the Hollower AP! This AP World is compatible with any 1.X.X AP Client

## [AP Client](https://github.com/Axertin/mth-apclient/releases) | [Setup Guide](https://github.com/FyreDay/Archipelago-MinaTheHollower/blob/main/worlds/mina_the_hollower/docs/setup_en.md) | [Readme](https://github.com/FyreDay/Archipelago-MinaTheHollower/blob/main/worlds/mina_the_hollower/docs/en_Mina%20The%20Hollower.md)

## Features

### Goals
- Repair Radiant Manor Generator (Roll Credits)
- Repair X Generators (Configurable from 1 to 6)

### Items
- Abilities (Burrow, Carry, Swim, Bounce, Climb, Spring)
- Trinkets
- Player Upgrades (Vials, Magic, Health, Sparks, Weapons)
- Underlab Improvements
- Train Tickets
- Locks (or Kears, configurable)
- Starting Item Set (Including Starting Weapon)
- Bone-Up Caps

### Locations
- Chests
- Buried Bonestone
- Shop Inventories
- Boss Kills
- In-World Item Pickups (Bonestone, Boss roses)

### Other Features
- Universal Tracker Map Support
- Deathlink (Sent on Sparkless Demise)
v1.0.0.title: v1.0.0
